attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Behavior change: previously HandleException rethrew non-fatal exceptions after logging, but the new LogException only logs and swallows them, silently changing error propagation in many display/editor pipelines (though old HandleException is kept but marked obsolete, so downstream custom callers still work)."}
